mapper.select:
AND cm.model_id = #{modelId}

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO apms_combo_model (model_id, normalization_method, formula, ref_version, algo_version) VALUES (#{modelId}, #{normalizationMethod}, #{formula}, #{refVersion}, #{algoVersion})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM apms_combo_model WHERE id IN #{id}
